description: The bar chart illustrates the popularity of different knowledge categories—specifically "Songs" and "Basketball"—across five distinct models or conditions: Llama3, Qwen2, ChatGPT, Acc=0 & GT Ans, Acc=0 & Gene Ans, and Acc=1 & GT Ans. The vertical axis, labeled "Popularity," ranges from 60 to 220, with horizontal gridlines at intervals of 40. The horizontal axis displays the two main categories, "Songs" and "Basketball," with each category containing a group of five bars representing the five models/conditions. The legend indicates that each bar is color-coded and patterned: Llama3 (blue, vertical stripes), Qwen2 (red, diagonal stripes), ChatGPT (yellow, crosshatch), Acc=0 & GT Ans (black, solid), Acc=0 & Gene Ans (black, diagonal stripes), and Acc=1 & GT Ans (white, outlined). For both "Songs" and "Basketball," the popularity values generally increase from left to right across the bars, with the highest popularity observed for "Basketball" under the Llama3 model, reaching approximately 220. The lowest values are for "Songs" under the Acc=0 & GT Ans condition, which is just above 60. The bars are arranged in a consistent order for both categories, and the chart visually emphasizes the significant difference in popularity between the two categories, with "Basketball" consistently having higher popularity than "Songs" across all models/conditions.
